# automation-master - Local-First Automation Governance & Credit Policy

> `automation-master` is a private-by-default, local-first control and governance module for recurring automation families. It registers comparable automation variants, calculates explainable reward scores, manages epoch-scoped credit envelopes, records governance receipts, and provides a separate logical runtime observer for native execution evidence.

Part of the dev-bricks ecosystem and open-bricks umbrella. Python 3.10+, MIT License.

## Core Capabilities
- **AutomationMaster Service**: Central controller for registry, epoch budgets, preflights, reservations, receipts, handovers, and deterministic projections.
- **Automation Registry**: Versioned local registration of automation families, variants, and configurations.
- **Credit & Budget Governance**: Epoch-scoped credit envelopes (`budget_epoch`), local SQLite `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` atomic reservations, and overdraft bounds (`SHADOW` vs `ENFORCED` modes).
- **Deterministic Reward Scoring**: `RewardPolicy` weighted calculation incorporating positive signals (interest, gap coverage, useful results) and negative signals (cost per result, NO_WORK rate, error rate).
- **Event-Sourced Ledger**: Append-only SQLite `events` table ensuring auditability, projection isolation, and conflict-free cross-host convergence via `sqlite-transit-sync`.
- **Receipt Retention**: 30-day detailed projection retention with immutable event payload hash audit preservation.
- **AutomationRuntime**: Closed, immutable, redacted runtime receipts derived from provider-native and scheduler-native readback, with explicit authority-resolution evidence and bounded statistics.
- **Contract Adapters**: Narrow seams for `ellmos-scheduler` (CreditGateAdapter), `system-gap-master` (DeploymentPlan), `sqlite-transit-sync` (ImmutableMergePolicy), and Antigravity prompt-repair invariant verifier.

## Boundaries & Constraints
- Does **not** schedule processes, execute tasks, or launch jobs (delegated to schedulers like `ellmos-scheduler`).
- Does **not** obtain authority from runtime evidence: definitions and approvals remain registry-owned; due time, leases, dispatch, and retries remain scheduler-owned; execution remains provider-owned.
- Does **not** store live SQLite databases in cloud sync directories (OneDrive); default database lives in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ellmos\automation-master\`.
- Runtime receipt storage is create-only outside configured OneDrive roots; raw prompts, provider output, errors, credentials, personal payloads, and source paths are not exported.
- Defaults to `SHADOW` or `DISABLED` mode to prevent unintended operational throttling.
- Zero network egress; operates 100% offline in standard user mode without administrative elevation.

## Verification & Status
- **Test Suite**: 66 passed (100% green via `pytest`).
- **Code Hygiene**: 100% compliant with `ruff check` (py310).
- **CI Matrix**: GitHub Actions multi-OS (`ubuntu-latest`, `windows-latest`, `macos-latest`) and Python 3.10-3.13.

## Key Files & Entrypoints
- CLI Entrypoint: `automation-master` (`automation_master.cli:main` / `python -m automation_master`)
- Python API: `automation_master.AutomationMaster`, `automation_master.EventStore`, `automation_master.CreditPolicy`, `automation_master.AutomationRuntime`, `automation_master.RuntimeReceiptStore`, `automation_master.read_provider_receipt`, `automation_master.read_scheduler_run`
- Runtime CLI: `runtime-provider-readback`, `runtime-scheduler-readback`, `runtime-record`, `runtime-stats`
- [README.md](https://github.com/dev-bricks/automation-master/blob/main/README.md): Primary English documentation, architecture overview, and usage.
- [README_de.md](https://github.com/dev-bricks/automation-master/blob/main/README_de.md): German documentation and quickstart.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/dev-bricks/automation-master/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Architectural boundaries, event models, and reservation protocols.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/dev-bricks/automation-master/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Security policy, local storage invariants, and confidential reporting contacts (`security@ellmos.ai`, `lukas@open-bricks.org`).
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/dev-bricks/automation-master/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history.
- [ellmos-module.v2.json](https://github.com/dev-bricks/automation-master/blob/main/ellmos-module.v2.json): Machine-readable module manifest.
- [contracts/automation-runtime-observation.md](https://github.com/dev-bricks/automation-master/blob/main/contracts/automation-runtime-observation.md): Runtime observation and ownership contract.
- [contracts/automation-runtime-observation_de.md](https://github.com/dev-bricks/automation-master/blob/main/contracts/automation-runtime-observation_de.md): German runtime observation and ownership contract.
